posts.text: Another day another libghostty-based project, this time a macOS terminal with vertical tabs, better organization/notifications, embedded/scriptable browser specifically targeted towards people who use a ton of terminal-based agentic workflows.
posts.notes: mitchellh spotlighting cmux (manaflow-ai/cmux) as a libghostty success story — agentic workflow terminal. 89K views, 764 bookmarks. Strong external validation of cmux relevance. Directly connects Ghostty ecosystem to agentic infrastructure.

posts.text: Here are a couple more projects that use libghostty: https://supacode.sh/ Supacode, an agentic coding app. And another libghostty based terminal for iOS: https://vvterm.com/
posts.notes: Supacode spotlight: 'Native terminal coding agents command center. Run 50+ coding agents in parallel.' Direct precedent/competitor to our tmux-based orchestrator. mitchellh explicitly validating the multi-agent-in-terminal architecture. Also vvterm iOS terminal. Ingest candidate: Supacode is directly relevant prior art for the orchestrator.
